t: Said before walking into something he expected not to return from
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْتَذِرُ إِلَيْكَ مِمَّا صَنَعَ هَؤُلاَءِ ـ يَعْنِي أَصْحَابَهُ ـ وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَيْكَ مِمَّا صَنَعَ هَؤُلاَءِ
m: O Allah, I excuse myself before You from what these people have done, and I disown before You what these others have done. Then he went forward and was struck more than eighty times.
